Hi Leo,

I have granted you the following access groups to match Priya Nair's access as requested:
- SYN-GRP-CONFLUENCE-FINANCE (Confluence finance space)
- SYN-GRP-FINREP-READ (Finance Reports readers)
- SYN-GRP-JIRA-WRITE (Jira editors)

Two groups require your manager's approval before they can be granted:
- SYN-GRP-FINREP-WRITE (Finance Reports editors)
- SYN-GRP-PAYROLL-ADMIN (Payroll administrators)

The request for these groups is with your manager for approval. I will update you once there is a decision.

Best regards,
IT Access Desk
